violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Establishment is not to use slicer until it is properly cleaned and sanitized. Deli slicer cleaning guide provided at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Soup and chowder were observed held between 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, food was taken in and out of unit during service. Owner elected to voluntarily dispose of food at the time of inspection. Proper food storage/cold holding reviewed with owner. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Ham was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, potatoes were placed hot and covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Potatoes were placed on to sheet pans to finish cooling at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026
The 2 door reach-in #2 gasket was observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
Establishment is lacking proper drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the hood system have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026
